note: Plans, prices and even ownership of these tools change monthly; recheck every row before teaching. Lovable, Cursor, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Copilot in the cloud, Devin and Jules were rechecked on 2026-11-23.

kinds.kind: Build an app from a prompt
kinds.for: founders, designers and product managers who want a working prototype without writing code

tools.name: Lovable
tools.what: A chat-based app builder that generates a full-stack web app (usually React with a Supabase backend) from a description and hosts it for you.
known_for: fast path from idea to hosted app, with Plan, Build and Chat modes and a built-in backend
built-in Quick and Deep security scans
persistent Instructions (previously called Knowledge) at workspace, project and personal level
watch_out_for: credit-based pricing, and credits are not refundable

publicly reported data exposure: a Lovable-showcased app leaked 18,697 user records (The Register, Feb 2026), and a Lovable API flaw left other users' project source code readable for 48 days (The Next Web, Apr 2026)
Lovable says fixing issues the scan flags is up to the app's owner
tools.price: from $25 a month (Pro, 100 credits)

tools.name: v0
tools.what: Vercel's prompt-to-app builder that produces Next.js and React interfaces and deploys them to Vercel.
known_for: tight link to Vercel hosting
good for interface and front-end work
choice of model tiers (Mini, Pro, Max)
watch_out_for: usage-based credits: model tokens are billed per million
the free plan is limited to 7 messages a day
output is built around Vercel's stack
tools.price: from $30 a user a month (Plus, includes $30 of credits)

tools.name: Bolt.new
tools.what: A browser-based app builder that writes, runs and deploys a full-stack project from a prompt.
known_for: runs the whole project in the browser
unused tokens roll over for up to two months on paid plans
free tier to try it
watch_out_for: token-based allowance that large projects can use up quickly
free plan has a 300K daily limit and Bolt branding
reported fall in traffic since June 2026 (Swedish press, single source)
tools.price: from $25 a month (Pro, 10M tokens)

tools.name: Replit Agent
tools.what: An agent inside Replit's online workspace that builds, runs and deploys apps from a prompt, with hosting and a database in the same place.
known_for: build, host and database in one product
works on mobile as well as desktop
Core plan includes $20 of usage credits
watch_out_for: effort-based, pay-as-you-go pricing makes cost hard to predict
Replit itself says agent behaviour is probabilistic and can make mistakes
projects live on Replit's platform
tools.price: from $20 a month (Core)

tools.name: Figma Make
tools.what: Figma's prompt-to-prototype tool, included with a Full seat, that turns a prompt or a design into a working app.
known_for: starts from your Figma designs
sits next to the design file your team already uses
no separate subscription for Full seat holders
watch_out_for: uses a shared pool of Figma AI credits
needs a paid Full seat for full access
Figma also bought the team behind a rival builder (Bud) in July 2026, which shows how fast this market moves
tools.price: from $16 a month (Professional, Full seat)

tools.name: Google AI Studio (Build mode)
tools.what: The Build tab in Google AI Studio generates a working app from a prompt, now full-stack and running on the Antigravity coding agent.
known_for: free to start with no card needed
export to GitHub or as a ZIP
Annotation Mode: highlight part of the UI and describe the change
watch_out_for: free quota can run out, after which you add your own API key
described by reviewers as still evolving and inconsistent in places
tied to Gemini models
tools.price: free to start

kinds.for: developers who want an agent inside the editor they work in every day

tools.name: Cursor
tools.what: A VS Code-style editor built around an AI agent that edits files across your project, with a Plan Mode and support for AGENTS.md and Agent Skills.
known_for: widely used agent-first editor
Ask, Agent, Plan and Debug modes (Shift+Tab), and /multitask for parallel agents
reads AGENTS.md, .cursor/rules and SKILL.md skills
watch_out_for: SpaceX closed its $60bn purchase on 14 August 2026, so ownership and model supply have changed
OpenAI said it would stop supplying its models to Cursor, proposing 12 November 2026; a Cursor forum post on 16 November said access was extended to 25 November
usage pools reset weekly, and third-party models are billed separately at API rates
tools.price: free with limited use of Cursor and Grok models; Plus $8 a month; Premium $30, which adds cloud agents

tools.name: GitHub Copilot in VS Code
tools.what: Copilot's chat, agent mode and Plan agent inside VS Code, with agent skills and repository instructions.
known_for: Plan agent that hands the plan to an implementation agent
works in VS Code, Visual Studio and JetBrains IDEs
reads AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md or GEMINI.md instructions
watch_out_for: since 1 June 2026 billing is by GitHub AI Credits (token usage), not premium requests
one user reported using about 15% of a Pro+ allowance in a single session on day one
code review also uses GitHub Actions minutes
tools.price: from $10 a month (Pro)

tools.name: Devin Desktop (formerly Windsurf)
tools.what: The Windsurf AI editor, renamed Devin Desktop and sold with Cognition's Devin agent.
known_for: Cascade agent inside an editor
free tier with unlimited Tab completions
bundled with the Devin cloud agent
watch_out_for: renamed in June 2026 and its plans were reset twice in 2026
daily and weekly usage quotas; extra usage is billed at API rates
plan details differ between sources, so check the page
tools.price: from $20 a month (Pro)

tools.name: Kiro
tools.what: An AWS editor and agent built around specs: a prompt becomes requirements, a design and a task list that the agent then works through.
known_for: spec-driven workflow stored under .kiro/specs
steering files, plus automatic AGENTS.md support
Agent Skills
watch_out_for: credit metering: complex tasks such as spec execution use more credits
the launch pricing was criticised in 2025 and AWS called part of it a bug
monthly credits do not roll over
tools.price: from $20 a month (Pro, 1,000 credits)

tools.name: Google Antigravity
tools.what: Google's agent-first development platform: a desktop app (Antigravity 2.0) and a terminal CLI that run several agents in parallel.
known_for: free Individuals plan
agent manager and artifacts for reviewing what agents did
supports Agent Skills, hooks and subagents
watch_out_for: plans and rate limits have changed repeatedly (a March 2026 price rise drew user protest)
baseline agent quota refreshes weekly
it replaced Gemini CLI, so tutorials written before mid-2026 may be out of date
tools.price: free for individuals; Business from $30 a seat a month

tools.name: JetBrains AI and Junie
tools.what: JetBrains' AI assistant and its Junie coding agent, inside IntelliJ-based IDEs.
known_for: native to the JetBrains IDEs
Junie draws on the same AI plan quota
free tier exists
watch_out_for: credit quota shared between assistant and agent; reviews report credits running out
quota figures differ between JetBrains help pages
less useful if your team does not use JetBrains IDEs
tools.price: about $10 a month (AI Pro)

tools.name: Zed
tools.what: A fast open source code editor with built-in AI, or your own API keys and external agents.
known_for: open source editor
free Personal plan works with your own API keys
listed as an AGENTS.md-compatible tool
watch_out_for: built-in AI is not on the free plan
usage beyond the included $5 of tokens is billed
smaller extension ecosystem than VS Code
tools.price: from $10 a month (Pro); editor free and open source

kinds.for: developers who hand a task to an agent and review the result, in the terminal, an IDE, the cloud or CI

tools.name: Claude Code
tools.what: A coding agent you run in the terminal, an IDE or the cloud, which reads your repository, edits files and runs commands.
known_for: plan mode, skills, hooks, subagents and MCP
claude -p for scripts and CI, plus an official GitHub Action
reads CLAUDE.md, and AGENTS.md when no CLAUDE.md exists
watch_out_for: AGENTS.md is read only as a fallback; if a CLAUDE.md exists it wins unless you import AGENTS.md
in non-interactive runs, calls that need approval are denied unless you allow them
subscription usage limits, or per-token cost on an API key
tools.price: included with Claude Pro, from $17 a month billed annually ($20 monthly)

tools.name: OpenAI Codex
tools.what: OpenAI's coding agent, available as a CLI, an IDE extension, a desktop app and cloud tasks, and included in ChatGPT plans.
known_for: codex exec for non-interactive runs
reads AGENTS.md, with AGENTS.override.md for local overrides
supports Agent Skills from .agents/skills
watch_out_for: usage limits differ by ChatGPT plan, and are limited on Free and Go
default sandbox is read-only, so you must opt in to edits
documentation has moved to learn.chatgpt.com, so older links redirect
tools.price: included with ChatGPT plans (limited on Free and Go; Plus $20 a month)

tools.name: Antigravity CLI (replaces Gemini CLI)
tools.what: Google's terminal coding agent, run as agy. It replaced Gemini CLI for individual users when Gemini CLI stopped serving them on 18 June 2026.
known_for: carries over Agent Skills, hooks, subagents and plugins
shares its agent harness with the Antigravity desktop app
importer for old Gemini CLI settings
watch_out_for: Google says there is no one-to-one feature parity with Gemini CLI
Gemini CLI still works with paid API keys and enterprise licences, so two products exist
built in Go and tied to Google's platform and quotas
tools.price: free for individuals; Business from $30 a seat a month

tools.name: Copilot in the cloud (formerly Copilot cloud agent)
tools.what: GitHub's cloud agent: it researches a repository, plans changes, implements them in a cloud environment and opens a pull request. Renamed, with a new experience, on 28 October 2026.
known_for: starts from github.com/copilot, the Agents tab, an issue assigned to Copilot, or @copilot in a pull request
runs inside GitHub with your branch protections
can fix failed Actions runs
watch_out_for: GitHub warns it can produce code with security vulnerabilities, so review everything
branch rules can block it unless you configure a bypass
uses a monthly allowance for cloud and Actions compute
tools.price: paid Copilot plans, from $10 a month (Pro)

tools.name: Devin
tools.what: An autonomous software engineer you give tasks to in the cloud, in a desktop app or by tagging it in Slack, Teams or Linear, which opens pull requests.
known_for: runs from chat tools and issue trackers
Devin Review for pull requests
scheduled and trigger-based automation
watch_out_for: usage allowances reset daily and weekly, and extra use is billed at API rates
team plan adds a base fee plus a seat fee
autonomous work still needs human review before merging
tools.price: from $20 a month (Pro); Teams $80 plus $40 a developer seat

tools.name: Jules
tools.what: An asynchronous agent that clones a GitHub repository to a cloud VM, drafts a plan and opens a pull request.
known_for: label a GitHub issue to start a task
shows a plan and a diff for review
daily task limits by plan
watch_out_for: read-only after 11 November 2026, and closing on 31 December 2026; Google points users to Antigravity
limited to 15 tasks a day on the base tier
GitHub only
tools.price: free base tier (15 tasks a day); higher limits with Google AI Pro and Ultra

tools.name: Aider
tools.what: An open source terminal tool for pair programming with a language model, working with cloud or local models.
known_for: git-centred workflow
works with many models, including local ones
listed as an AGENTS.md-compatible tool
watch_out_for: you pay your model provider directly
terminal only
I could not confirm the current maintenance pace from the pages read
tools.price: free; you pay your model provider

tools.name: Cline
tools.what: An open source coding agent available as a VS Code extension, JetBrains plugin, CLI, desktop app and SDK.
known_for: Plan and Act modes
asks approval for each edit and command by default
works with many model providers and MCP servers
watch_out_for: you pay your model provider by usage
auto-approve lowers the safety checks
the JetBrains plugin's source is not open
tools.price: free and open source (Apache 2.0); you pay your model provider

tools.name: OpenCode
tools.what: An open source coding agent with a terminal interface, desktop app and SDK, supporting more than 200 model providers.
known_for: MIT licence
log in with an existing ChatGPT or Copilot subscription
listed as an AGENTS.md-compatible tool
watch_out_for: free models vary and may change
quality depends on the model you pick
OpenCode Go is a separate paid service
tools.price: free and open source (MIT); optional OpenCode Go from $10 a month

kinds.for: product, marketing and sales people who work with documents, meetings, research and data rather than code

tools.name: Claude apps (Projects, artifacts, Cowork)
tools.what: Claude on the web, desktop and mobile, with Projects for shared context, artifacts for documents and small apps, and Cowork, an agent for knowledge work on your files.
known_for: Cowork is generally available on all paid plans
enterprise controls such as role-based access and usage analytics
Claude Code included in paid plans
watch_out_for: Cowork availability differs by surface (desktop, web, mobile) and plan
usage limits by plan
an agent acting on your files needs supervision
tools.price: from $17 a month billed annually, $20 monthly (Pro)

tools.name: ChatGPT (Projects, agent)
tools.what: OpenAI's assistant, with Projects, an agent mode and Codex included in its plans.
known_for: lower-priced Go tier
Codex included in every plan, with different limits
an always-on agent called Dot on the Pro plan
watch_out_for: Go launched alongside advertising, per press reports
plan names and limits changed during 2026 (a $100 Pro tier appeared in April)
the pricing page I read showed no prices, so these come from press
tools.price: from $8 a month (Go); Plus $20

tools.name: Gemini and NotebookLM
tools.what: Google's Gemini app, plus NotebookLM, which answers questions and builds summaries from sources you upload.
known_for: answers grounded in your own sources
bundled with Google AI plans
cheap entry plan
watch_out_for: plans were restructured in May 2026 and price changes followed
NotebookLM access varies by plan
check data handling terms before uploading client material
tools.price: from $4.99 a month (Google AI Plus); AI Pro $19.99

tools.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot
tools.what: Copilot built into Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and Teams, working over your organisation's Microsoft 365 data.
known_for: works where office documents already live
uses your tenant's permissions
a cheaper Copilot Business tier for small organisations
watch_out_for: an extra per-user licence on top of Microsoft 365
reports disagree on the current Copilot Business price ($18 or $21)
value depends on how tidy your SharePoint and permissions are
tools.price: $30 a user a month (enterprise add-on); Copilot Business reported at $21

tools.name: Notion AI
tools.what: AI inside Notion workspaces: an agent, meeting notes and search across your pages and connected tools.
known_for: works on the docs your team already keeps in Notion
AI meeting notes
enterprise search (beta)
watch_out_for: full AI features need the Business plan; Plus and Free have only a trial
enterprise search is still in beta
price shown in pounds on the page I read
tools.price: from GBP 16.50 a member a month (Business, includes AI)

tools.name: Glean
tools.what: Enterprise search and an assistant that works across a company's connected apps and documents.
known_for: searches across many workplace tools
per-user subscription plus pooled FlexCredits
sold to large organisations
watch_out_for: no public price list: pricing is by sales quote
advanced AI use draws on FlexCredits, and billing for learned memories began on 7 November 2026
third-party estimates of seat cost vary widely
tools.price: quote only, no public price

tools.name: Granola
tools.what: A meeting notes app that listens to your calls and combines your own notes with a transcript to write a summary.
known_for: audio deleted after transcription
configurable transcript retention
SOC 2 certified
watch_out_for: Granola trains on anonymised data unless you opt out (off by default on Enterprise)
recording other people needs their consent where the law requires it
HIPAA compliance applies to Enterprise only
tools.price: from $14 a user a month (Business)
